simple.meaning: Elishua , the son of King David
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֱלִישׁוּעַ (H474) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱלִישׁוּעַ (ʼĔlîyshûwaʻ) means Elishua , the son of King David First listed occurrence: 1Chr 14 5.

definitions.short: Elishua , the son of King David
definitions.full: H474. Elishua אֱלִישׁוּעַ proper name, masculine ( God is salvation , compare אֱלִישָׁע below; or is opulence , compare אֲבִישׁוּעַ ) son of David 2Sam 5:15 ; 1Chr 14:5 .
definitions.rootNote: from 410 and 7769 ; God of supplication (or of riches);
